words: Has a nation ever changed its gods, though they are no gods at all?
Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking the LORD your God when He led you in the way?
what will you gain on your way to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile?
How could you turn yourself before Me into a rotten, wild vine?
How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’?
As the thief is ashamed when he is caught
where are the gods you made for yourselves?
Why do you bring a case against Me?
Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash?
How unstable you are, constantly changing your ways!
If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him to marry another, can he ever return to her?
Would not such a land be completely defiled?
like a nomad in the desert
How I long to make you My sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of all the nations!

how bitter it is, because it pierces to the heart!

how can you compete with horses?

why are You like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays but a night?

Do the skies alone send showers?
Is this not by You, O LORD our God?

Did Hezekiah not fear the LORD and seek His favor, and did not the LORD relent of the disaster He had pronounced against them?
